question: In 2009, AR Rehman won Oscars in which of the given pair of categories?

options.text: Best Sound Mixing and Best Original Song
Best Original Musical and Best Sound Mixing
Best Original Score and Best Sound Mixing
Best Original Score and Best Original Song

solution:
The correct answer is __**Best Original Score and Best Original Song**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2009, AR Rahman won two Oscars for his work on the film **Slumdog Millionaire**.
 
• He received the award for **Best Original Score** for the film's musical score.
 
• He also won the award for **Best Original Song** for the song "Jai Ho" from the same film.
 
• These wins made AR Rahman the first Indian to win two Oscars in a single night.
 
• The soundtrack of "Slumdog Millionaire" was widely acclaimed and played a significant role in the film's global success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AR Rahman**:

 
 
• AR Rahman, also known as the "Mozart of Madras," is a renowned Indian composer, singer, and music producer.
 
• He has composed music for numerous Indian and international films, earning him multiple awards and accolades.
 
 
 
• **Slumdog Millionaire**:
 
 
• Directed by Danny Boyle, "Slumdog Millionaire" is a 2008 British-Indian film that tells the story of a young man from the slums of Mumbai who competes on the Indian version of "Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?"
 
• The film was a critical and commercial success, winning eight Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Director.
 
 
 
• **Academy Awards**:
 
 
• The Academy Awards, also known as the Oscars, are annual awards presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences to recognize excellence in cinematic achievements.
 
• The awards are considered the most prestigious in the film industry.
 
 
 
• **Best Original Score**:
 
 
• This award is presented to the composer of the best original music score written specifically for a film.
 
 
 
• **Best Original Song**:
 
 
• This award is presented to the songwriters who have composed the best original song written specifically for a film.
 
• The song "Jai Ho" from "Slumdog Millionaire" was composed by AR Rahman, with lyrics by Gulzar.
